description: W1 — DEK wrapping at rest (B8 §8.4.1, D55): AES-256-CBC + HMAC-SHA256 in Encrypt-then-MAC, subkeys derived from the KEK via HKDF-Expand (RFC 5869; Extract omitted, the KEK is already uniform). IV is FIXED ONLY FOR THE VECTOR (production wraps with a random IV). The wrapped DEK is the V6 DEK, so the two vectors show the same key in use and at rest. Layout: wrapped_dek = IV(16) || CT || HMAC(32). Subkey derivation: subkey = HMAC-SHA256(KEK, UTF8(label) || 0x01). Demonstrations: W1a — unwrap(wrapped_dek, kek) returns the DEK; W1b — flipping any byte of wrapped_dek fails the MAC check BEFORE decryption (DEK_WRAP_AUTH_FAILED, no padding oracle); W1c — a different KEK derives a different mac_key, so the MAC never verifies: a wrapped DEK is useless without the Vault KEK.
